_comment_purpose: GRASS repository MCP server config (Day 5 install). Scoped filesystem server only.
_comment_rule: Charter rule: ≤5 MCP servers active per session. Tier-1 (filesystem) added Day 5; Tier-2 deferred until Month 2.

filesystem._comment_scope: Args[0] is the repo root '.', which @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem resolves to absolute. This means the server can read/write anywhere inside GRASS/, which is the intended scope for a solo-founder day-to-day workflow.
filesystem._comment_alternate_scope: To harden, replace '.' with an absolute allowlist such as '/Users/camer/DEVNEW/GRASS' once an MCP-aware permissions model lands. For Day 5 the working-directory scope is sufficient because the agent is already inside this repo.
